name: spec-pdf
description: Renders docs/SPECIFICATION.md to a print-ready PDF.

scripts.build: node build.js ../../docs/SPECIFICATION.md ./out && node print.js ./out/cover.html ./out/cover.pdf cover && node print.js ./out/body.html ./out/body.pdf body && python3 merge.py ./out/cover.pdf ./out/body.pdf ../../docs/SPECIFICATION.pdf
